# `⊆` — Nest / Partition

`⊆Y` encloses atoms and simple arrays. Already-nested arrays stay unchanged.

```apl
⊆1 2               ⍝ ⊂1 2
⊆1                 ⍝ ⊂1
```

`N⊆Y` partitions along the leading axis. Each partition is a block of major cells. Zero omits, and a rise in the mark starts a partition.

```apl
1 1 0 1 1⊆"abcde" ⍝ "ab" "de"
1 1 0 2⊆4 2⍴⍳8    ⍝ [[0 1 ⋄ 2 3] [6 7 ⋄]]
```

Marks are nonnegative integers. Unit and singleton marks extend. `N⊆⍠K Y` partitions along axis `K` instead. `N⊆⍤1 Y` partitions each row. Unlike [`⊂`](enclose.qmd), positive marks need not start a partition at every position.

```apl
1 1 0 1 1⊆⍤1 ["abcde" ⋄ "fghij"] ⍝ ["ab" "de" ⋄ "fg" "ij"]
```
